content.title: Broadcast Information | Charlotte Hornets
content.text: Stream Directly with FanDuel Sports NetworkFans in North Carolina and South Carolina can subscribe directly at FanDuelSportsNetwork.com or in the FanDuel Sports Network app with a monthly or annual subscription.Watch on Prime VideoFanDuel Sports Network is available as an add-on subscription through Prime Video. To subscribe: visit Amazon.com.Through Your TV ProviderFanDuel Sports Network Southeast is carried by major cable, satellite, and streaming providers including DIRECTV (satellite and streaming), Fubo, Spectrum and U-verse. For providers in your area, visit GetMyHomeTeams.com. Fans subscribed to a TV provider can also stream games on the FanDuel Sports Network app and FanDuelSportsNetwork.com for no additional charge.Over-the-Air SimulcastsThese select games will also stream for free on Pluto TV and Prime Video.2025-26 OVER THE AIR SCHEDULELog In To Watch With TV ProviderSubscribe to FanDuel Sports NetworkFanDuel Sports Network Customer Support tickets@hornets.com 704-HORNETS Chat With Us open chat Your Privacy ChoicesWe use cookies and other tracking technologies on our online services.
